BELIEVEYOUME , Keyword Index

A keyword-search (inverted-index) lookup built around the chapters of the current BELIEVEYOUME work product. v1 indexes the 10 chapters alone. v2 keeps the chapters as the spine and sub-indexes the iximusic corpus, the ixi-generative corpus, the theory-book extracts, the reference-corpus PDF library, and the classics monographs , so one keyword resolves to which chapter plus which source backs it. This is the keyword kind of index, not the semantic/RAG kind.
